units.text: This module contains the LeRobot implementation of **Real-Time Chunking (RTC)**, an inference-time technique for flow-matching based policies.
**Note**: RTC is not a policy itself, but rather an inference enhancement that works with flow-matching based policies including [π₀](⟦0⟧), [π₀.₅](⟦1⟧), and [SmolVLA](⟦2⟧).
